material_decision_evidence_paths: Paths without ../ resolve within evidence; text after a colon identifies the term/row inside that complete file. Paths with ../ refer to the explicitly named parent-batch or final-package document as described in the decision.
originals: Both complete frozen original trees remain at ../tibetan and ../english. Their manifests pin all originals, failed and superseded attempts. They are not recopied recursively.
physical: evidence/physical-excerpts.json retains complete relevant physical excerpts and original frozen-file hashes; whole-source pins are in evidence/input-references.json via the original verification records.
final_versions: No failed canonical final attempts. history/decisions-01 preserves the superseded depth/anaphor rationale sidecars; final spec/body bytes never changed after the successful runs.
